text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inside the venue, many fans eagerly await the appearance of Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Is it almost time? I can't wait to see her run.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You said Manhattan Cafe is also running? They seem to butt heads quite often, no?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That other time, Agnes Tachyon proclaimed her as her rival, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oh really? Then we're in for a show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Agnes Tachyon is paying a visit to Manhattan Cafe's prep room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why, hello. How are you doing, Cafe? Did you sleep well?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'd like to focus… so can you please leave me alone?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! It's assuring to see you're your normal self!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, I intend on going all out today. Since you're my rival, I hope you would do the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe shoots a glance at the hand extended her way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I… will not become your punching bag.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I will outrun you, and catch up to my friend. That's why I'm here, after all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she accepts the handshake. A fire burns in her eyes, to which Agnes Tachyon nods with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't expect anything less!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rising excitement outside the runners' tunnel is almost tangible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone's waiting for the living legend Agnes Tachyon to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes, I can feel their energy! The determining factors of significance are all here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a disappointment it would be if I failed to surpass my limits now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Indubitably, Trainer! Keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She turns and takes off in a brisk jog towards the light at the end of the tunnel.
